column1: # Altium <-> IR layer projection — REFERENCE copy — do not edit.
# The code operates on the WORKING copy (altium_layers.tsv); if that is
# missing or unparseable, it falls back to THIS file.
# The layer mapping is a property of the Altium importer/exporter, not of the
# IR, which is why it lives in data you can edit rather than in code.
# Columns (whitespace-separated):   IR   ALTIUM
#   IR      : IR layer number. A "_TOP" Altium key is PAIRED — the code
#             derives the bottom side automatically ("_BOTTOM" <-> -IR), so
#             list only the top row. Standalone keys have no side.
#   ALTIUM  : either a fixed layer NAME (Top, Bottom, TopOverlay, ...) or a
#             MechanicalLayerKind enum name (ASSEMBLY_TOP, COURTYARD_TOP...).
# WHY KINDS AND NOT NUMBERS. Altium's mechanical layers are numbered 57..72
# (Mechanical 1..16) but what each one MEANS is chosen per project — one
# design puts Assembly on Mechanical 2, another on Mechanical 13. The
# meaning is DECLARED in the file (PcbLib/PcbDoc `mechanical_layer_kinds`),
# so it is read, never guessed from the number. An earlier version of this
# mapping keyed off the number's PARITY (odd -> fab, even -> courtyard) and
# put BC2087's Assembly Top (Mechanical 2, an even number) onto tKeepout
# together with the real courtyard — the exact failure this table exists to
# prevent.
# A mechanical layer whose kind the source does not declare, or a kind with
# no row here, is carried onto a plain user layer and logged — never
# silently guessed onto a semantic layer.
# --- fixed (non-mechanical) layers, stable ids ---
1     Top
121   TopOverlay
131   TopPaste
129   TopSolder
# --- mechanical layers, addressed by DECLARED kind ---
151   ASSEMBLY_TOP            # assembly drawing -> tDocu 51 / F.Fab
139   COURTYARD_TOP           # placement outline -> tKeepout 39 / F.CrtYd
151   COMPONENT_OUTLINE_TOP   # body outline is assembly-drawing content too
151   ASSEMBLY_NOTES          # no side
120   BOARD                   # board outline -> Dimension 20
120   BOARD_SHAPE
148   FAB_NOTES               # Document 48
148   DIMENSIONS              # dimension annotation, no side
# --- parked on plain user layers, deliberately NOT given a semantic home ---
# Both are real drawn content, so they are carried; neither gets guessed onto
# a semantic layer. Declared here rather than left to the unmapped fallback
# so their numbers are STABLE: the fallback derives the number from the
# Mechanical SLOT, and the same kind sits on different slots per project
# (COMPONENT_CENTER_TOP = Mechanical 4 on BC2087, Mechanical 16 on RoXY).
#   BODY_3D_*        : 3D body outline. Arguably assembly-drawing content
#                      (user, 2026-07-27) — move to 151 if that settles.
#   COMPONENT_CENTER_*: an Altium workaround for not showing the footprint
#                      origin. IR HAS a real origin, so this carries no
#                      information for us (user) — kept only so nothing is
#                      silently dropped.
216   BODY_3D_TOP
217   COMPONENT_CENTER_TOP
